problem_type: localized display text persisted as user data
symptom: Prompt-library entries created without a title displayed Chinese placeholders and source labels in the English UI, and switching languages could not repair the stored text.
direct_cause: addUserPrompt and updateUserPrompt wrote the rendered literals 未命名提示词 and 我的 into persisted records, while several cards, previews, accessibility labels, and notifications rendered prompt.title or prompt.source directly.
class_root: The prompt-library storage contract did not distinguish stable semantic values from locale-dependent display text, and display consumers had no shared projection for legacy persisted literals.
affected_population: English UI users creating untitled prompt-library entries
Users switching language after creating prompt-library entries
Existing installations whose prompt-library files contain legacy localized title or source literals
entry_points: PromptPreviewOverlay title, source, image alternative text, and dialog label rendering
internal_only_reason: This invariant is entirely owned by Nomi's prompt-library storage schema and i18n display boundary; no external API or dependency decides which fields are stable persisted values.
invariants: Untitled user prompts persist an empty title and user provenance persists as origin=user rather than as a localized source label.
Every user-visible prompt title or user-source label is derived at render time by promptDisplay from the active locale.
Legacy persisted untitled literals in either supported language are treated as semantic untitled values without rewriting user files.
User-authored non-placeholder titles and curated proper-noun sources remain unchanged.
generality_proof: The write boundary no longer emits locale-dependent values, and all current title/source display consumers found by repository-wide prompt.title and prompt.source scans converge on promptDisplay. The display boundary recognizes both historical placeholder forms, so new writes and old stored rows follow the same locale-independent contract.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Persist stable prompt identity, content, and provenance values without rendered locale text.
Project stable and legacy persisted values into text for the currently active UI locale.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both create and edit paths now persist an empty untitled value and never write a localized user-source label.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: prompt card title, source, tooltip, and image alternative text
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Every visible or accessibility-facing value is obtained from promptDisplay rather than directly from persisted placeholders.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: preview dialog label, heading, media alternative text, and source badge
same_class_entry_points.evidence: The preview computes one localized display title and uses the shared source-label projection.
The notification displays the projected title while Undo writes the original stable title back to storage.

recurrence.reason: Any future write fallback or direct rendering consumer could persist or expose the locale active at creation time, and every existing legacy row can reproduce the issue after a language switch.
same_class_scan: Searched electron/promptLibrary and src/workbench/promptLibrary for 未命名提示词, source: 我的, prompt.title, and prompt.source.
Checked the create, edit, card, preview, tooltip, accessibility-label, and deletion-notification paths independently.
Verified the legacy Chinese and English placeholder populations under both supported locales.

prevention.invariant: Persisted prompt-library values are converted to locale-dependent text only at the shared display boundary.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown values remain user-authored text rather than being guessed or rewritten; known legacy placeholders are projected through i18n, and regression tests fail if either locale leaks the stored literal.
prevention.strategy: Keep semantic emptiness and provenance in storage, recognize legacy values on read, and route every current display consumer through one projection module.

legacy_paths.rationale: The supported store and components were corrected in place; there is no parallel legacy implementation. Historical data remains readable through the display projection.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The defect is in repository-owned persistence and rendering semantics, not in i18next or another third-party package version.

migration: No destructive file rewrite is performed. Existing rows containing 未命名提示词 or Untitled prompt are recognized as untitled at display time, and origin=user overrides historical source labels. New and edited rows persist stable empty values.
residual_risks: A user who deliberately chose a title exactly equal to a historical placeholder will see the active-locale placeholder instead; the stored value is preserved.
Curated non-user source names remain verbatim because they are treated as proper nouns; a future descriptive source field would need an explicit translation identity.
